I'm down to a two-player endgame against greens with four houses apiece, so their rent is brutal. I've got the light blues as a monopoly with $669 cash, and building three houses each would cost $450, leaving me only $219 against rents over $1000—too risky unless I factor in mortgage value from Baltic, Oriental, Vermont, and Conn.

Counting my unmortgaged properties, I have roughly $860 in liquidity I could tap plus the light blues themselves, so building 3 houses each on the light blues for $450 nets good rent (270/270/300) while still leaving enough total liquidation value—cash, mortgages, and half house value—to survive one hit from the greens. I'll go with 3 houses on each light blue property.
